text: I feel like I am exploring a place dedicated to the intersection of innovation and knowledge. The glass walls and countdown timer evoke a sense of anticipation, as though something important is about to begin, perhaps a presentation or a meeting of minds. Moving further inside, the R+D display with its bright colors and interactive screens invites curiosity and engagement. I feel inspired and alert, ready to absorb new ideas and question how humans and machines will continue to evolve together.
